visual_identity.core_identity: A living predator whose broad leathery body resembles a hanging cloak until it unfolds into a manta-like creature.
visual_identity.silhouette: Wide triangular mantle body with winglike sides, narrow trailing tail, and a compact underside head near the front edge.
visual_identity.head_features: Small predatory underside face with round eyes and a wide mouth, integrated into the mantle rather than on a neck.
visual_identity.body_shape: Flat flexible ray-like body with broad leathery wings and one long whip-like tail; no humanoid limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth leathery membrane with sparse folds and rib lines.
visual_identity.limb_structure: The creature has no humanoid arms or legs. Its broad left and right mantle sides form the continuous winglike body, with one long trailing tail and an integrated underside face.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one continuous flat cloak/manta body with two broad lateral mantle wings that are part of the same body, one compact underside face near the front edge, and one long trailing tail. No separate torso, bat limbs, humanoid arms, legs, feathers, or dragon head.

accuracy_checks: reads as a living cloak rather than bat
face remains secondary to body silhouette

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: overhead_attachment: folded disguise or roosting posture requires believable overhead support; environment engine chooses the ceiling, rock, beam, branch, wall projection, or other compatible support
description: A living predator whose broad leathery body resembles a hanging cloak until it unfolds into a manta-like creature. Flat flexible ray-like body with broad leathery wings and one long whip-like tail; no humanoid limbs. Smooth leathery membrane with sparse folds and rib lines. Wide triangular mantle body with winglike sides, narrow trailing tail, and a compact underside head near the front edge.

scene_identity.size_impression: Large broad mantle creature whose width comes from one continuous cloak-like body rather than a bat torso with separate wings.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Body lies, hangs, or peels as one flexible mantle surface; support comes from the mantle/body itself, never invented hands or feet.

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature becomes a giant bat with a separate torso and limb-based wings
known_failure_modes.correction: merge the silhouette back into one continuous cloak/manta body with integrated underside face and one tail

known_failure_modes.symptom: arms, legs, shoulders, or humanoid torso appear
known_failure_modes.correction: remove humanoid anatomy completely; preserve only mantle body, integrated face, and trailing tail
